newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in livelier trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in livelier trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in livelier trade on Tuesday with food processor Podravka taking the spotlight.
* Seven of 15 active issues rose, five fell and three were flat.
* Volume rose to 9,405 units and turnover to 4.0 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer hotelier Zlatni Rat rose 90 kuna to 200 on volume of 81 shares.
* Biggest decliner hotelier Laguna Porec lost 40 kuna to 1,400, selling 254 shares.
* Most actively traded stock Podravka inched up 0.9 kuna to 317.9 on volume of 4,692 units.
